mainHero.body:
Parallel Space scans real-world spaces
to build digital twins with measurable accuracy.
By adding quality management and ontology,
we turn reality into structured data with meaning and relationships.
mainHero.pEngineCaption: The digital twin solution that captures industrial sites as precise 3D data
mainHero.pHouseCaption: The platform that integrates and manages residential spaces with 3D data, from move-in preparation to defect management.

industry.headingLead: How to Turn an Entire Real Space
industry.subtitle: Parallel Space's 3D technology reduces rework, accelerates verification, and minimizes adoption risk.
industry.coreStrengthHeadline:
Not AI-generated “plausible” virtual objects and spaces,
but accurate 3D data captured from the real world.
industry.chip2Desc: Minimal manual work for large-scale field data conversion
industry.chip3Desc: Built for environments where external networks aren't available
industry.chip4Desc: Tool-agnostic, connects with a range of simulators
industry.case1Desc: Automatically compares 3D scan data with design drawings to detect and record deviations.
industry.case1Problem: Manual spot-checks make it difficult to verify site-wide deviations.
industry.case1Solution: Automatically compares full-site scans with BIM and design data.
industry.case1Value: Visualizes deviations, catches errors early, compares the entire site, and automates reporting.
industry.case2Desc: Automatically reconstructs on-site data into 3D geometry ready for immediate use in CAD and simulation.
industry.case2Problem: Differences between existing drawings and actual site conditions make it difficult to review changes or expansions.
industry.case2Solution: Converts scanned facilities into models ready for design and simulation.
industry.case2Value: Fewer site revisits and less manual modeling, with better review before changes.
industry.case2Impl: A precise 3D digital twin of an industrial parts machining line
industry.case3Desc: Automatically reconstructs environment geometry from real site data for robot training.
industry.case3Problem: Differences between virtual environments and real sites can cause unexpected errors after robot deployment.
industry.case3Solution: Builds robot training and validation environments based on the real site.
industry.case3Value: Catches errors before deployment, reducing early testing costs and operational risk.
industry.case3Impl: 3D assets and a simulation package for developing advanced autonomous manufacturing scenarios.

housing.subtitle:
Connects move-in preparation and defect history to an accurate 3D model captured from real-world measurements.
Accumulated management data becomes the foundation for more efficient operations and quality management.
housing.feature1Label: Key Feature 01 · Shared & Unit Defect Inspection
housing.feature1Title: One Entry — From Defect Classification to Data
housing.feature1Desc:
Select a location and take a photo of the defect. AI automatically handles everything from trade classification to data capture.
Accumulated spatial data becomes the foundation for recurring defect analysis and predictive maintenance.
housing.feature1StatTitle: Defect Data, Organized as You Inspect
housing.feature1StatDesc: Select Location · Take Photo → Classify · Measure · Document · Capture Data
housing.feature2Title:
Try Your Furniture in Your Home,
Before You Move It In.
housing.feature2Desc:
Any furniture a user brings can be instantly turned into a 3D model and placed at true scale within an accurately measured unit.
The experience of "bringing the furniture you actually want" — that's what sets P-HOUSE apart.
housing.coreStrengthHeadlinePre: As precisely located defect data accumulates, an
housing.coreStrengthHeadlineBold: inspection tool becomes a prediction tool.
housing.pointBad: Other services close the record once a defect is "resolved" — the data scatters, and the next inspection starts from a blank page.
housing.pointGood1: P-HOUSE stores every defect as 3D coordinate data, turning defect history into an asset that gets smarter over time.
housing.pointGood2: P-HOUSE transforms a building's entire defect history into a valuable data asset.
housing.lineupSubtitle: Connecting everything from move-in preparation to inspection, repair, and data asset creation.
housing.lineup1Desc: Defects are logged at precise coordinates within a 3D representation of the actual space, guiding repair teams directly to the exact location.
housing.lineup2Desc: From 2D location tagging to AI-powered trade classification, measurement, documentation, and database entry — all in one flow.
housing.lineup3Desc: Places photographed furniture at true scale in an accurately measured unit, allowing you to preview its size and layout in advance.
housing.lineup4Title: Defect History as a Data Asset
housing.lineup4Desc: Accumulates location, trade, cause, and resolution history to analyze recurring defects and identify vulnerable areas.
housing.case1Desc: Connects a resident's photographed defect to its exact location in the measured 3D unit. Residents and HQ CS teams share the same spatial data, reducing the effort needed to identify defect locations.
housing.case1Problem: With only a dot and a list on a 2D floor plan, the actual defect location still has to be identified manually.
housing.case1Solution: Links defect information directly to 3D spatial coordinates.
housing.case1Value: Precise location sharing, connected service workflows, and accumulated defect history.
housing.case1Example: Samsung C&T Raemian pre-move-in inspection · Hestia A/S app
housing.case1Impl: A pre-move-in inspection and service app.
housing.case2Desc:
Select a location on site and photograph the defect. Classification, measurement, documentation, and database entry are connected automatically.
Accumulated defect data extends into defect analysis and predictive maintenance.
housing.case2Problem: Manual location marking, measurement, official documentation, and database entry.
housing.case2Solution: Simplifies the workflow to selecting a location and taking a photo.
housing.case2Value: Less time spent on site, fewer missed entries, and the same information shared across stakeholders.
housing.case2Example: Xi S&D common-area defect inspection automation app
housing.case3Code: Try That Exact Piece of Furniture in Your Home First
housing.case3Desc: Instead of choosing a similar item from a predefined furniture library, generate a true-scale 3D model of the exact furniture you choose and place it in your real space.
housing.case3Problem: Virtual interiors and furniture often don't match real-world dimensions, making purchase decisions difficult.
housing.case3Solution: Generates and places image-based 3D furniture within an accurately measured unit.
housing.case3Value: Supports purchase decisions before move-in and reduces trial and error in moving and placement.
housing.case3Example: GS E&C Xi furniture placement simulation service, POSCO The Sharp AI living curation
